[**June 27, 1862:** In Hanover County, Virginia, near Gaines’ Mill, the Union V Corps had established a defensive line north of the Chickahominy River. There, Union troops initially beat back oncoming waves of Confederate attacks with heavy casualties, but by the evening, Gen. Robert E. Lee’s troops were more organized, ending with Confederate victory when Maj. Gen. George B. McClellan decided to abandon the campaign. ](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=b95972f93f3d462b8125f1ffafee943a&_e=gFpV6LVOdEdAq48qKEEaV98FBDdkSfLUTZtkQBk1rZ6svn8qLxFIA_8znr9OO2WwKuxZoS1wtPOI1imhDcXPtjXkoF3glbxE17qC5-Spn2k5whauA3bi5mXvIm1v40mIk3MgSTMIecuY0KxMF5AKJhXJddrzjMmlg8g0v9Bo3jMJy104KLhXNJHYkHRhsFNXiSGy5BOsX8wINzHnZCUilFnCl6TTR0zy0ZR3S_tnK6fJ-0P753M3BngLS5XFxnPd) **Source -[battlefields.org](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=b95972f93f3d462b8125f1ffafee943a&_e=gFpV6LVOdEdAq48qKEEaV98FBDdkSfLUTZtkQBk1rZ6svn8qLxFIA_8znr9OO2WwKuxZoS1wtPOI1imhDcXPtgScizfdbJGdz0TCH_cAhKMDguhymR-xGHAEpvr-zxKXrKAybkKQhiYfpwQnuOJ_jepsKfMtLUh-Q0-X5UCaymnOSB5bmnm50eeQIs14Kv94vJFawgDKMvSOZ1FqO-MImHBUCgUuNlAsBWtCaRFQqdGGIlJdjeZ95h7Xp86QQLof)**

[**June 27, 1950:** The United States officially entered the Korean War to support the Republic of Korea (South Korea) and repel an invasion from the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea). Japan had controlled the Korean Peninsula during WWII, and after Japanese surrender, control of the peninsula was split between U.S. and Soviet troops. The Korean War was a proxy for the Cold War, and at its end, the border between North and South Korea remained virtually unchanged.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=b95972f93f3d462b8125f1ffafee943a&_e=gFpV6LVOdEdAq48qKEEaV98FBDdkSfLUTZtkQBk1rZ6DU3icxTu5TZziUiB-GWPqwvrmHEF8F8jFfFK_4bh4kL1t1NyzWIsrWe_LlU1eaWzziR_7fdxBFpOQDipdBJeF82jD-7qKsnLTmBbmIbzxXQ6GWGrNa_JunNndEccNHUoODzspU6KNEKGmifGBvUO28zai1-mEG-YTozVwsr6knIi_BbG18GJBS1mPRojDW8SQv-0OIJ_fGlmcLPe-VeG8) **Source -[nationalgeographic.org](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=b95972f93f3d462b8125f1ffafee943a&_e=gFpV6LVOdEdAq48qKEEaV98FBDdkSfLUTZtkQBk1rZ6DU3icxTu5TZziUiB-GWPqwvrmHEF8F8jFfFK_4bh4kL1t1NyzWIsrWe_LlU1eaWzwW9d56BOVOoNHnD6QKW_-UQMrnp6Yxl0CmZlgEwCl8slUI01eFp69TrSN2tlyH6S-AI__qQ_lccxCaNIKC4M3qe4QS8W4IsJJzQnetGCa2i2jzb5RkVPoSUaZnIB5jnu2a2nx0ybkofvBFDE0OvAS)**

Peter,
Unlike many professional politicians, I didn't have any special privileges or family connections to help me get to where I am today.

Let me take a moment to introduce myself – my name is Lori Chavez-DeRemer.

__My passion for public service started at the local level.
__
In 2004, I was elected to the Happy Valley City Council, and in 2010, I was entrusted with the responsibility of serving as the city's Mayor. For eight years, I had the privilege of working closely with the community, addressing their concerns, and striving to improve the lives of our residents.

During my time as Mayor, I focused on fostering economic growth, promoting community engagement, and enhancing the quality of life for Happy Valley's residents. It was an incredible experience that deepened my understanding of the challenges faced by our local communities and the importance of effective leadership in addressing those challenges.

In 2016, I took the leap to pursue higher office. After a successful run for the Oregon House District 51, I, unfortunately, fell short in the general election. Nonetheless, this experience only fueled my determination to continue fighting for the values and principles that I believe in.

Fast forward to the present, and I am humbled and honored to represent Oregon's 5th congressional district as a member of the United States House of Representatives. Since assuming office on January 3, 2023, I have been steadfast in my commitment to serving our district, advancing policies that promote economic growth, protecting our natural resources, and supporting the aspirations of our hard-working citizens.

As a member of the Republican Party, **I am proud to be the first Republican woman to represent Oregon in the House of Representatives.** This achievement is a testament to the progress we are making in breaking barriers and embracing diversity in our political landscape.

Throughout my journey, I have been fortunate to have the unwavering support of my loving husband, Shawn, and our two wonderful daughters. They have been my rock, providing me with the strength and inspiration to persevere in the face of challenges.

clean_body: | | | | I didn’t have any special privileges. Peter, Unlike many professional politicians, I didn't have any special privileges or family connections to help me get to where I am today. Let me take a moment to introduce myself – my name is Lori Chavez-DeRemer. My passion for public service started at the local level. In 2004, I was elected to the Happy Valley City Council, and in 2010, I was entrusted with the responsibility of serving as the city's Mayor. For eight years, I had the privilege of working closely with the community, addressing their concerns, and striving to improve the lives of our residents. During my time as Mayor, I focused on fostering economic growth, promoting community engagement, and enhancing the quality of life for Happy Valley's residents. It was an incredible experience that deepened my understanding of the challenges faced by our local communities and the importance of effective leadership in addressing those challenges. In 2016, I took the leap to pursue higher office. After a successful run for the Oregon House District 51, I, unfortunately, fell short in the general election. Nonetheless, this experience only fueled my determination to continue fighting for the values and principles that I believe in. Fast forward to the present, and I am humbled and honored to represent Oregon's 5th congressional district as a member of the United States House of Representatives. Since assuming office on January 3, 2023, I have been steadfast in my commitment to serving our district, advancing policies that promote economic growth, protecting our natural resources, and supporting the aspirations of our hard-working citizens. As a member of the Republican Party, I am proud to be the first Republican woman to represent Oregon in the House of Representatives. This achievement is a testament to the progress we are making in breaking barriers and embracing diversity in our political landscape. Throughout my journey, I have been fortunate to have the unwavering support of my loving husband, Shawn, and our two wonderful daughters. They have been my rock, providing me with the strength and inspiration to persevere in the face of challenges. | | Thank you for your continued support, Peter. Without you, this journey wouldn’t be possible. Thank you, Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. Aside from that, all you need to know are the issues she’s fighting for in Congress: If that sounds like the kind of agenda you can get behind, If you’d prefer to give by check, please use the below address: Lori Chavez-DeRemer for Congress 13203 SE 172nd Ave Suite 166 #399 Happy Valley, OR 97086 Forward This message to FIVE FRIENDS AND FAMILY to spread the word on how to achieve a better future for Oregon and America → ** Also text “LORI” to 71800 or click here to receive all of Lori’s messages | | | | Lori Chavez-DeRemer 13203 SE 172nd Ave, Suite 166 #399, Happy Valley, OR 97086

name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: We are committed to staying in this fight until we have fair maps in every state, for every American.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
|
---

Team -- today, the Supreme Court of the United States ruled in favor of North Carolina plaintiffs in the case _Moore v. Harper_ , an appeal filed by North Carolina Republicans that sought to give state legislatures **near-total control** over federal election laws, including but not limited to congressional redistricting. **This is the second victory for our affiliate this Supreme Court term following the win in the redistricting case,_Allen v. Milligan_.**
_Moore v. Harper_ was a federal appeal of _Harper v. Hall_ , a landmark state court case in which the North Carolina Supreme Court originally determined that the congressional map enacted by Republicans in the state legislature was an unconstitutional partisan gerrymander. As a result of that ruling, a state court ultimately adopted a fair congressional map leading up to the 2022 election and upheld that map in December 2022.
By rejecting the independent state legislature theory, the Supreme Court preserved the vital role state courts play in protecting free elections and fair maps for the American people. [**This is a victory for our system of checks and balances, the cornerstone of American democracy.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65531995/413712558/1138990540?refcode=20230627_AOTL_P_EHHMooreHarper_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUwMDhjY2I4LTQ2MTUtZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kHTA_T13gdaBFdB-VeoqSynuEaTiAFaEwGrZh4289w0=)
Make no mistake, this appeal and the truly fringe, truly ideological theory it espouses should never have been brought before our nation’s highest tribunal in the first place, and it demonstrates the lengths to which too many in the Republican Party are willing to go in order to bend — even break — our democracy in order to hold onto illegitimate power.
As the North Carolina legislature revisits the redistricting maps, it should keep in mind that the purpose of a legislative body is to represent and make real the will of the people. Plain and simple.
For the past six years, All On The Line and our affiliates have been fighting in both state and federal court for fair maps that protect and strengthen the right to vote for all eligible Americans. Our success in front of justices and judges, in state and in federal court, has resulted in unequivocally fairer maps for voters around the country. But there is more work to be done.
**We are committed to staying in this fight until we have fair maps in every state, for every American.**

****_All On The Line is the grassroots advocacy campaign supported by the National Redistricting Action Fund. Support our work to end gerrymandering._**

#
Josh Hawley is getting worried, Peter.
**Just read what he told his top donors in a message about his race against Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat:**
**_“Let me be clear: control of the Senate COULD come down to this seat...”_**
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34657?refcode=em20230627-3326&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3326%2E614464%2E6k1UMn)**
After proving to the world that he’s a fraud and a coward on January 6th and failing Missourians in the U.S. Senate, Josh Hawley made himself one of the most vulnerable GOP Senators up for re-election this cycle.
**IN MARCH:** An approval poll showed Hawley underwater with Missourians — a net-negative rating with growing “intensely negative sentiment” among voters.
**IN APRIL:** After months of desperate attacks from Hawley’s insider friends at the National Republican Senatorial Committee, our campaign managed to outraise Hawley’s by nearly 2-1.
**AND THEN:** Another one of Hawley’s top supporters, Big Tech billionaire Peter Thiel, announced they won’t back him in this election. Thiel has donated hundreds of thousands of dollars to Hawley’s previous election bids and reportedly said he won’t support any Republicans this cycle due to their out-of-touch culture wars.
**All of this means we have a real opportunity to defeat Josh Hawley and take Missouri’s Senate seat back for the people next year, but it’s not going to be easy.**
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/34657?refcode=em20230627-3326&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3326%2E614464%2E6k1UMn)**
**GOP insiders at the National Republican Senatorial Committee are doing everything in their power to make Josh Hawley look strong.** They launched one of their very first attack ads this cycle against Lucas Kunce and — on the very last day of the most recent FEC fundraising quarter — used their joint committee with Hawley to transfer _$250,000_ directly to his campaign.
**That’s why we need your help today, Peter.** Our next FEC fundraising deadline is on Friday — and we still need to close the gap on our goal of raising 30,000 individual donations before the end of the quarter.
Reaching this goal means we’ll have the resources we need to keep holding Hawley accountable and getting Lucas’ vision for Missouri in front of voters as soon, and as often, as possible. **So please:**
**[Will you rush a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford to our grassroots movement to elect Lucas Kunce? subject: Three reasons why I need your help this week
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends - as your Member of Congress, my first responsibility is addressing the very real problems Americans are facing and coming up with real solutions.
It’s a responsibility I take seriously and one of the driving forces behind why I’m running for re-election. Last year, when we got word that the Supreme Court was going to strike down Roe v. Wade and strip away the constitutional right to an abortion, my team and I got to work.
While extremist Republicans were (and still are) focused on stripping away more of our rights and rolling back decades of progress, I was (and still am) focused on protecting people and their privacy. We must do whatever we can to protect people right now while we fight to make abortion a legally protected right across the country.
I introduced the My Body, My Data Act to protect our reproductive and sexual health data and to prevent our personal information from being weaponized against us.
But the fight doesn’t stop there. Far from it.
Right now, I need your help to ensure my campaign has the funds we need to run and win next November. To keep up this fight, I need to build a formidable campaign – and this week, I could really use your support for a few reasons:
1. June 30th is a major fundraising deadline for every candidate running for office (more on that below!) and the optics here really matter.
2. We missed our fundraising goal last month, so we have to push a little harder right now to make up the difference.
3. I have a right-wing opponent who is way too extreme for our district – and I can guarantee he’ll be fundraising this week too.

With all this in mind, we are setting an ambitious goal to raise $3,500 via email by the end of the week so we can show everyone the strength of our campaign. Can you help us? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
When our team closes the books on Friday and submits a report to the FEC for the quarter, that report will be made public. Everyone – from political journalists to the Republicans who want to flip our district red – will see how our campaign is performing and use it to make projections about the race.
This last part is so important. We have a chance to show the rest of the world what we know so well – that our progress and our power as a movement isn’t fleeting – it’s solid and here to stay.
And as a bonus, we can make sure we don’t give my right-wing opponent any motivation in this fight or his donors any hope that more money will help them win next November.
So, I’m coming to you because I’m going to keep delivering solutions to the problems we face, but I need your help to make it happen. Will you chip in any amount and help us reach our goal before Friday’s deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately.

Thanks so much for being here. It means a lot.
-Sara

## State Legislatures Lose Election Authority
The U.S. Supreme Court ruled Tuesday that [state legislatures](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAQQL_G7hzBDMamoLgmXa690oJhSDhhYwFJtH-_ytZbPr3m6f27bTeXcjruf93OtseyOerpxZvQE6wT4AZjsJEZGEe2Uq-LmSUgjg8rvI-BZ-8iCYMBdTAxGEl61qQ84ZgsCEChYRVmBikuwcUFJTEGqZRWZlCCQ-qlXv6XdPQHx_xVXlwvVPYx20fvZxvwzwDXAa7uPPjdPuoDtSfKPMC1Pc_KO09UnrVPnJl6KkebWnedp8z31LLrz8ptchpE8CtJF1BEQuXReUGr9GD8utBYbTjfKefU9DIocd9dyj8t_fc13wEAAP__kAFmUg) don't have the authority to set election rules without oversight from state courts.

The decision undercut an argument by some states-- this case involved North Carolina -- that legislatures are the final authority on issues of gerrymandering and the voting process. Instead, courts will still have the final say.

The 6-3 decision was written by Chief Justice John Roberts, joined by the [three liberal justices and two conservatives,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOgzAQBb_GdEbrtQO4cHENXa69Ejl4CY4MRvYmKH9_ytXXveJJM5qf63T1McX9_u03crzkyc8cXzRBJ3GQqCdsgluIkHRDTnVDby8KtW5WR94PN4_KAvThZkgtnbVGDxgWMHDRTXQIqKHDAewFFbTBL71WM-mgjOmMFQYoRM6lfeS480pLeucXlXbOW5PcynxUob8EjgLH8zzbI6fIcc6fg8Bxp7MKHD8UgSN0n90LHOvzKLSRnPOzsCz0oJmrjHugg_ZAO8vKnkkmuseaPD8LSV4pl7cEUKB7q5viwnHGlGLtemHgvvmY_rz4_0y_AQAA__-eZ2hy) Brett Kavanaugh and Amy Coney Barrett.

She'll stand up for choice, gun safety, democracy and so much more that we care about._ [**_Will you join Blue Amp Action in giving Wilson $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can to remove despicable coward Jim Jordan from the House?_**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T84383293-5e9b-4896-99a7-066276bf3d63/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Thank you for standing up to this stain on our democracy._ Cliff

subject: Jensen/Ladapo: Restoring Public Trust in Healthcare
body:
Watch our Newsmax segment | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/drscottjensen/newsmax?e=9828080a05)
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

I recently appeared on [Newsmax TV](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=43d29eeabc&e=9828080a05) with Florida Surgeon General Dr. Joseph Ladapo. We were lied to for years, and now the so-called experts want you to forget it happened. That's why debate, open discussion, and accountability is so important. [Please watch](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=b6927006d7&e=9828080a05) and share this critical segment, where we explored how to restore public trust in health professionals. Click the thumbnail below [to watch](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=17112c0087&e=9828080a05):
---
| [ ](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=434ae28a97&e=9828080a05 "How to Restore Public Trust of Health Officials")
---
| In order to learn from past mistakes, open debate and candid conversations are required. Recently, a high-profile vaccine advocate and scientist, Dr. Peter Hotez, [refused to debate](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=30191bb329&e=9828080a05) Democratic Presidential Candidate Robert F. Kennedy Jr. - instead dismissing him as a "conspiracy theorist."

The era of arrogant dismissal must end and the era of open conversation must start. That's what [Dr. Joseph Ladapo and I advocate for](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=6bf40722c6&e=9828080a05); you should too! If ideas are good and withstand scrutiny, they should be debated. That's how science and medicine moves forward.

Be blessed today!

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | **Dear Friend,** | **Discover how your support powered the fight to protect Avi Kwa Ame!** | [SEE YOUR IMPACT](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1847813?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
A simple ‘thank you’ is just not enough for the work you’ve helped power with your support. As a dedicated member of Friends of the Earth, you have allowed us to fight for the future of our planet, the vulnerable species that inhabit it, and the most iconic and important natural spaces around us. Together, we are making strides in our work towards a healthier and more just world. **[See your impact.](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1847814?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
You are powering change, Friend. Your donations supported efforts to protect our planet over corporate profits. You allowed us to keep up the fight to protect the natural spaces most important to communities from destructive development, critical habitats for local fauna, and ensured that future generations can enjoy these areas.
**Thank you for making a difference! **
[READ MORE](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1847813?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Avi Kwa Ame, also known as Spirit Mountain, is considered sacred by 10 Yuman-speaking tribes and is a culturally important landmark for Mojave and Sothern Paiute people. It provides habitat for many species found nowhere else on Earth. But the threat of development would destroy the landscape and harm these communities.
Supporters like you refused to sit back and watch this threat become a reality. You amplified the voices of the communities urging President Biden to protect the land as a National Monument.
After President Biden announced his intention to officially designate Avi Kwa Ame as a National Monument during the White House Tribal Summit in November, we knew we couldn’t let up until he followed through.
Supporters like you sent over 33,000 messages directly to the White House in the following months, and Avi Kwa Ame was officially designated as a National Monument by President Biden in March. The declaration is the result of years-long advocacy campaigns led by Tribes, frontline and conservation groups working with the Honor Avi Kwa Ame coalition. These designations provide permanent land and resource protections in accordance with the Antiquities Act.
**Read more about your impact on protecting Avi Kwa Ame for future generations! **
[SEE YOUR IMPACT](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1847813?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Our work continues. In Alaska, the Willow Project will stain the Arctic with pollution and oil for all who call the region home -- including the area’s Indigenous residents. This project will decimate the ecosystems that have supported Indigenous Alaskans for millennia. And it threatens the already vulnerable caribou population -- a resource many local communities rely on. We are working to fight back, and with you by our side, I know we can prevail.
Fighting to save our planet is hard work. But your support inspires us every day, and we won’t give up until our planet is prioritized over private profit.
We could not do this work without you. Thank you for being there with us, persisting after every setback and celebrating every victory. We are so proud to work with you to make the world a better place.
**Standing with you,
Raena Garcia,
Senior fossil fuels and lands campaigner,
Friends of the Earth**
|

body:
Peter, Your safety, along with the safety of your children and loved ones, is at stake. Senate Democrats are moving a bill,
|

| Peter, Your safety, along with the safety of your children and loved ones, **_is at stake_. ** Senate Democrats are moving a bill, S-524, that would give prosecutors the authority**to divert dangerous offenders from the criminal justice system** **without jail and without ever talking to a judge.**
This would allow SERIOUS CRIMINALS avoid court (and jail) entirely. Heard enough? **[Click here to send a message to your state senator (it takes less than a minute) to let them know you demand they oppose this dangerous legislation.](https://xtz223.keap-link004.com/v2/click/b7de59cce7f12caf67fb233642dd69db/eJyNj00LgkAQQP_LnCVz7YO8iYiI5iHqHIsOtKjrso2Zif-9taIuBV1n3rzhDUAouaS4AA-udGPMBQs05kIJlBQ0knj-2LLlwnEdCyohy0g3rQJv-Hr8Bqax46yZBdQrNMh-5wdJnEXHNM4SQyquzY-_PJvVRxNu_TiFcfzpxVpQeDHqM3ikW5yCCmGi6KArw5-IlGfbXdfNiJdoAkUj2Zy5s7ypzT1XCmXxak-wf1rGO0ahYVw=)** In nutshell, if S-524 passes, then when a criminal is arrested for sexual assault, first or second degree violent crime, gun assault, arson or an offense under Megan’s Law, they would be allowed to:
1\. Avoid court and give a prosecutor SOLE DISCRETION to put them into a diversion program as long as a social worker (not a doctor) says they are depressed or suffer from 4 or more other “mental health” issues (which include loss of appetite, unexplained weight loss or weight gain, trouble sleeping, fidgeting or nervousness - not making that up; it’s literally in the bill) 2\. Avoid jail. There is no incarceration. They serve a non custodial release term that can’t extend more than 2 years, during which there is no consequence for not completing the program or reoffending, and they can be admitted to the program as many times as they commit crimes. 3\. When they complete the program they have a congratulatory graduation ceremony and their charge is expunged (adding insult to injury for the victims). 4\. There is NO JUDICIAL REVIEW. The Prosector decides who goes in and who comes out. There is no court date.
---

We cannot allow a prosecutor the power to divert a child molester or a violent criminal who shot someone from the criminal justice system without the approval of a judge.
We cannot allow our streets to be riddled with criminals who should be in jail. Please join me in [contacting your state senator about the dangers of S-524 now.](https://xtz223.keap-link004.com/v2/click/a235cd18b65f318dbc7544c102b15167/eJyNj8EKgkAQQP9lzlK5lpS3EAnRPESdY9GBFnV32cbMxH9vrfBU0HXmzRteD4SSS4oLCOBOD8Y8cMBgLrRASaGSxPPXlq2Wruc6UAlZ7oxqNAT91-MJGMeu668doE6jRY6HbZjE2e6cxlliSc2N_fGXZ-OzSRPtt3EKw_DTi7Wg6GbVVwjINDgGFcJG0clUlr8Q6WA-b9t2RrxEGyiUZAvmzXJV23uuNcri055g97YMT0qNYWE=) Bill

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: American Update
subject: Our country is facing a constitutional crisis
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c660783%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fAkvCGa6xV3MIw1VHprB5Q&sysid=1)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c660784%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=b2oA%2f4jgY0NzCWkup9QSwg&sysid=1).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It’s a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of “We the People” is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can’t just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION --to DO SOMETHING about it, while there’s still time to save our country. **

That is why I’m writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of “We the People”--before it’s too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c660795%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CT1tL0l6uGN41Jgamytydg&sysid=1)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Who rules whom?
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zng5ohqog65uq2htej01lsalqi6otmsdvku3fho0_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjhm9o74cph2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze9ophfqk07ao1obu1bkjq594oso58a5oi2n3mco_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjhm9o74cph2bs).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8qnus0olj9hip4juqposd7lsq2n0leh49n4jbng_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjhm9o74cph2bs)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zutps0k47cju4sqaor0rbgt9o3nrc57meek9k29o_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjhm9o74cph2bs)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.
---

| | Peter,
---
| An overwhelming majority of Americans on numerous polls have indicated that the debt ceiling increase should have happened only with spending cuts.

When Republicans introduced the [Limit, Grow, Save Act](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=62f7ba0d84&e=0e51d1e991), which would have cut spending while also raising the debt ceiling for critical programs, every single Democrat voted against it. _Including my incumbent opponent Kim Schrier._

Out-of-touch politicians brag about out-of-control government spending while it threatens our nation’s security, worsens our economic situation and devalues the hard-earned dollars of Americans!

In less than **48 hours** , my end of quarter fundraising deadline will be here. Let’s show every politician who turned their back on the people by escalating our national debt crisis that we are putting them on notice!
---
|
---
| After the deadline at midnight on June 30th, the fundraising support for my campaign will send a message to Washington Democrats and the DC Lobbying Cartel.

Peter, help me make sure that message demonstrates how fed up Washingtonians are with reckless federal spending on Radical Left projects that restrict their freedoms and force them to live within guidelines they have no choice about!

[**Chip in now**](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=e48018943a&e=0e51d1e991) to show that the people of Washington are determined to have leaders that will put the brakes on Big Government power and spending!

Greg joined workers on the picket line in Austin.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65538559/413761509/1120393829?refcode=em-wrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmVjOTFjYi1iMzE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nCABNga-Q2VY_A6RB7SLyuxcP4KD-V4wbXnxPZVS5Rc=&emci=44ec91cb-b315-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=46ec91cb-b315-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=6830379)
Peter,

This was history in the making.

**Yesterday, Greg joined nurses from Ascension Seton Medical Center in Austin on strike to call attention to inadequate staffing that makes it difficult to provide health care to patients.**

name: Andy Kim
subject: What the divide in our country really looks like
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
I used to think that the opposite of democracy was a dictatorship. But what I've come to really believe is that the opposite of democracy is apathy .

Democracy is about engagement and stepping up – giving the power to the people to create the kind of change they want to see.

Apathy is a sense of helplessness, a sense that your voice or vote doesn't matter. Why bother if the problems are too big, that our government is too broken and can't be fixed?

I believe in the power of democracy. I still believe in America. That's because I've witnessed real change happen when people step up and engage . Democracy cannot be done alone. It's a collective effort. The more people that engage with our democracy, the stronger it becomes.

We're building a movement of people who believe in the power of democracy and engagement. We need you to help power this movement for change. Can you chip in $14 now before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2023-06-28-eoq-democracy&recurring=0&amount=14&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=91cc65f2-b315-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73]

I've learned a lot about what the divide in our country really looks like.

Oftentimes people think about these "battlegrounds" – whether districts or states – as sort of this Democrat army versus this Republican army.

The fight here is not just between Democrats and Republicans.

It's between people who are engaged and people who are not. It's a division of engagement that we're facing as a country.

We cannot surrender to apathy. Engagement wins the fight for our democracy, one person at a time.

Please join us today in this critical movement.

Our end-of-quarter deadline is quickly approaching. We need to raise $7,650 more. Can you pitch in now and be part of the change? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2023-06-28-eoq-democracy&recurring=0&amount=14&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=91cc65f2-b315-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73]

Let's reignite hope and belief in our great American experiment. Together we are strong, together, we can create meaningful change, and together we can shine as a beacon of hope to democracies around the world.

More soon,

Andy

name: ICYMI News
subject: Who rules whom?
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z10radhhpbqlejf22mnuetgdv3mdd17m2fhrt208_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjjm8or2clh2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8vtfjokbt31j2vitmpq4qa7q2vsr1c38bflm44o_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjjm8or2clh2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state—that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoau8b5nbja3gueol0tb65go0ghiaq7d4qussje8_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjjm8or2clh2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zad3lugg0eltkmgtajc49sj53680odgphlcukhj8_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjjm8or2clh2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: Are you ready to finish what we started?
body:
I'm Running for Congress because I want our community to have the best Representative in Congress that we can.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/SD%20Email%20Collage.png]
Friend,
I am proud of the campaign we ran for Congress in 2022. When I decided to make that run, I knew that it was going to be an uphill battle for many reasons, not the least of which was that I was different than any candidate who had run in PA-10 before.
Together, we surprised everyone by mounting a campaign that came closer to defeating a Republican incumbent than any other 2022 U.S. House campaign in PA.
As the June 30th fundraising deadline approaches, I am asking you to recommit to my campaign so we can finish what we started. Click here to donate now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
That campaign was something we all did together. I'm running for Congress again this cycle because I believe that I am the best person for the job, and I'm asking you to support me once again because this time we'll win - together.
Can you pitch-in $25, $50, $100, $250 or more to support the campaign before Thursday's deadline? Click here to pitch-in! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
I've spent my life doing difficult things and taking on tough fights. I became an immigration attorney because I knew that so many people needed someone fighting for them against a system that was stacked against them. I ran for Harrisburg City Council because I wanted to give my community strong representation and help those that felt like no one was on their side.
Last year, I ran for Congress for those same reasons. You believed in me, and together we almost won the fight. This year, we can finish the job, but only if we continue to fight together.
Click here to make a contribution before the June 30th deadline! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thank you for your support in 2022, and thank you in advance for your continued dedication to our common goal.
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

name: Sepi Shyne
subject: Women have always been on the forefront of change
body:
Hi there,

As the first out LGBTQ+ Iranian woman elected to _any_ political office, I want to honor the courageous activism and movements — led by women, the LGBTQ+ community, and people of color — who've paved the way for my candidacy to ever be possible.

From women's suffrage to the #WomanLifeFreedom movement in Iran, from the struggle for abortion rights to the activism that sprung up after the election of Donald Trump, it's been women leading the fight for their own liberation and a more free and equitable world.

[**I'm running for CA-30 to keep building on that fight. From voting rights to abortion rights and equal pay to equal representation, I'm ready to fight with everything I have to secure an equitable future for women everywhere. Chip in $5 to join me in this fight.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65543669/413781907/-262033478?refcode=em23_23_ws2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM5MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGU3NDU1ZDItYjkxNS1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=889JseuGPH72ClMIdbDJ7mYG-9nMCY5u4-ebV6bT1yo=)

I was born in Iran and spent the first few years of my life in fear of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard watching our every move. Women's rights were trampled on and we were not allowed to be in the streets with men or boys who were not our family.

I cut my hair short and pretended to be a boy to play soccer with the neighborhood kids. I remember kicking the ball around under the hot Tehran sun just as vividly as I remember fleeing the country with my parents and escaping to the United States for a better life.

While moving to the United States provided me with the opportunity to pursue higher education, become a small business owner, and now run for Congress, recent far-right attacks on women and the LGBTQ+ community in this country serve as a terrifying reminder of the conditions we fled from in Iran.

I see it in the extremist efforts to control women's bodies and the right to choose, in bills that attempt to legislate LGBTQ+ people out of existence, and in efforts to block policies like paid family leave and equal pay that would level the playing field.

**This is why I'm running to represent CA-30.** Extremism in the U.S. threatens to undermine the generations of work and activism that women and allies have fought so hard for. But with your support, we can and will resist it.

[**Donate $5 or any amount you can to my campaign to protect the right to choose, the right to love who you love, and to keep working towards true gender equity and justice.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65543684/413781922/-262033478?refcode=em23_23_ws2&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM5MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGU3NDU1ZDItYjkxNS1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=889JseuGPH72ClMIdbDJ7mYG-9nMCY5u4-ebV6bT1yo=)

For women, LGBTQ+ people, and those who've been marginalized and silenced in this country for too long: It's OUR time to Shyne.

With gratitude,

Sepi Shyne
#WomanLifeFreedom
_Mayor Sepi Shyne has taken on WeHo's biggest issues and delivered results. From raising the minimum wage to the highest in the nation to significantly reducing homelessness – she's running for Congress to fight for all of us. As the first out Iranian LGBTQ+ woman elected anywhere in the world, Sepi is committed to making the American dream a reality for everyone: For immigrants, the LGBTQ+ community, women, and anyone trying to make ends meet. House Bill 281 is a bill aimed at enhancing public participation and strengthening enforcement in the energy siting process. It elevates the status of the public's input to that of an intervenor, giving ordinary citizens a stronger voice in shaping decisions related to energy siting. The bill also involves the Department of Energy's enforcement division, which brings specialized expertise and resources to effectively monitor and enforce energy siting certificates. Additionally, HB 281 seeks to streamline municipal net metering and reduce regulatory costs, benefiting ratepayers and taxpayers alike.

body:

Friend,

Last month, I proudly endorsed Gabe Amo for Congress in Rhode Island’s 1st District .

I’ve known Gabe for almost twenty years, and he’s always showed up for Rhode Islanders and our Newport community.

Mayors need partners in Congress who we can count on to show up and deliver help when it matters most. Gabe Amo was often the first call from the White House that my colleagues across the country received when they were guiding their communities through their darkest moments and hardest challenges.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105455/images/FwDA6HvWwAIxceF.jpeg]

Gabe has served at the highest levels of the government under former Governor of Rhode Island, Gina Raimondo, and in the White House for two Presidents, President Obama and President Biden. Gabe is the only candidate who has proven he has the skills, compassion and connections to navigate Washington, D.C. to deliver for Rhode Islanders on day one.

We need a Congressperson who understands Washington – to deliver results for Rhode Islanders, protect the rights that we hold dear, and to stand up to extremists in Congress.

The White House and the Department of Justice (DOJ) are in full panic mode. **They're desperately trying to cover up their alleged corruption, hoping their lapdogs in the media will continue to keep the truth from the American people.** But the evidence is mounting, and even the corporate media can't ignore this anymore! | | I hope you are doing well, friend.

I wanted to send you a quick update on my husband's race. Just three weeks in, and Chris’s **clear and direct message** to voters is resonating. Recent polling already has Chris rising in the polls, clearly shaking up the race.

[This most recent national poll has Chris at 5% already, surpassing most of the field of candidates.](https://chrischristie.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7d3b914c82f8277858a0eba20&id=1a1d71c0a4&e=172a9e88c0)

This is clear momentum that others in the race did not see coming. Americans are desperately looking for leadership that doesn’t pander to the crowd in the moment. My husband has demonstrated his unique ability to take on those who aren’t always telling the truth, something most refuse to do.

But we need your help if we want to keep the momentum. We’re approaching our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we have to show a strong showing in our first report. [Can I count on you to chip in today to count toward the initial report?](https://chrischristie.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7d3b914c82f8277858a0eba20&id=35aede960d&e=172a9e88c0)

We don’t take asking you for financial support lightly. The RNC established a new rule, requiring candidates to have 40,000 individual donors to get on the debate stage.

Our country deserves to have someone like Chris on that stage. No one is better equipped, and frankly, no one is willing to take on Donald Trump directly like my husband is. **That’s why I’m counting on you to make sure we hit the 40,000 individual donor goal. **

Will you be one of the first 40,000 to donate? [Donate here before the end-of-month deadline >>> ](https://chrischristie.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7d3b914c82f8277858a0eba20&id=cefc599386&e=172a9e88c0)

This campaign is just getting started, and I’m so excited to see where it will be in just a few months from now. I hope you’ll be on the team with us along the way for this journey.

All my best,
Mary Pat Christie

Team, earlier this month **our movement for fair maps received incredible news** when the Supreme Court issued its decision in _Allen v. Milligan_. The Court reaffirmed the Voting Rights Act and affirmed a lower court decision striking down Alabama’s congressional map for unlawfully diluting the political power of Black voters.

**But unfortunately, I have to be the bearer of some bad news: The GOP’s efforts to undermine our elections aren’t going anywhere.** | _Slate_

**“There Are Still Two Major Legal Threats to the Voting Rights Act”

_“There’s no reason to expect that voting rights’ opponents will drop their attacks as they seek to maximize the power of white majority voters.”_**
---
**Republicans are as determined as ever to use anti-democratic tactics like gerrymandering and voter suppression to silence voters – especially voters of color.

Alexandria doesn’t curry favor with billionaires and we don’t host fancy cocktail fundraisers with wealthy donors. We rely on people contributing to emails just like this one to reach our goals.

body:

---
We were just made aware of a wonderful scholarship program from the Foundation for the Restoration of America. Scholarships can be used to further the education of award recipients at universities, private high schools, and trade schools. There are two $10,000 scholarships, two $5,000 scholarships, and thirty-five $2,000 scholarships available. **The deadline for fall semester is this Friday, June 20th!** **The deadline for spring semester is December 31st.**** ****From their website:** _There is a need for a citizenry educated in the core body of knowledge about what makes America exceptional, and our vision is to restore a prideful history in the education of our young Americans. We invite you to learn about America’s founding through our FREE online Constitutional program and apply for a scholarship._ For more requirements, details, and the application,****[**please visit FFROA’s website.**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-Gddw) Good luck! Jenny Beth Martin

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: It wasn’t an accident
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
We need to keep making bold change as a country. Not a nibble here, a piece over there.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=293%2E791427%2EewPSVG)
Friends,
My life’s work has been around one central question: What’s happening to hardworking people in America?
What’s happening to hollow out America’s middle class? Why has the road to economic security gotten so rocky and steep — and even rockier and steeper for people of color?
Well, here’s the answer: It wasn’t an accident. It was because a series of decisions changed who Washington actually works for. I saw a government that only worked great for those with money and power — for those who could hire armies of lobbyists and lawyers. Corruption, pure and simple. So I got in the fight.
I’m fighting for a government that works for families trying to make it payday to payday without getting ripped off — not just giant financial institutions.
I’m fighting for a government that works for people trying to fill a prescription — not just giant drug companies.
I’m fighting for a government that works for everyone who sees the climate crisis bearing down on us — not just Big Oil.
I’m fighting for a government and an economy that works for everyone. That means running for re-election to pass more of the big, bold action we need — like a wealth tax, universal child care, and an end to Washington corruption.
**[But none of us can get this done alone. It takes a grassroots movement where we fight side by side. We have a lot on the line.
#
**Unlike George Santos, I will always lead with the truth — so here goes:**
Friday marks our _very first_ end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since we launched our campaign to unseat Santos and we have a lot on the line.
The amount we raise will become public, for everyone to see. Both Republicans and Democrats will use it to judge the strength of our campaign. In fact, party leaders have told me that they need to see us maintain our early fundraising momentum for them to support us.
[**To show them that we have what it takes to win, our team has set an ambitious fundraising goal — $30,000 by Friday at midnight. I’ll get into the details more in a minute, but if you already believe in our campaign to stop Santos and his radical, right-wing cronies will you chip in $5 now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/zm-email-20230628?amount=5&refcode=em20230628&refcode2=132_8507_VsQ8ri&akid=132%2E8507%2EVsQ8ri)

A lot of people have been asking me what it will take to unseat George Santos, and here is what I tell them.
George Santos is only the second Republican to represent my home district in the **_over 60 years_** my family has lived here. He rode in on the MAGA wave that swept races all around the country and now people are seeing him for who he truly is: a phony and an embarrassment.

Electricity is probably one of the most important modern-day conveniences man has ever experienced. Just look around and take note of everything using electricity. It's amazing to think how the ability to harness this natural power affects our lives. Cheap, easily available electricity is one of the reasons the quality of life in the United States is well above the vast majority of the world.
Thanks for reading Dana Criswell! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGFuYWNyaXN3ZWxsLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTI1NzQxMzk0LCJzIjoxNTI2NzgxLCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNjg3OTY3MzI4LCJleHAiOjE2OTA1NTkzMjgsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.d_JQC0RsB-4qKcU-N68L_qPpDLwkkej8QDkUBkvEvMk?)
The Biden administration and the rest of the hate-America crowd are working overtime to destroy our access to cheap, abundant energy.
If you lived in Texas during the winter of 2021 you remember the extreme winter blast that sent the entire state of Texas into record breaking cold temperatures. Texans turned up the heat demanding electricity like never before, but this demand created a shortage of power and produced black-outs throughout the entire state.
**Why did Texas run out of electricity and what can we do in Mississippi to ensure we never have the same experience?**
Texas has fallen prey to the religion of renewable energy and in 2021 it left them in the cold. Those who worship at the alter of renewable energy tell us we must transition our energy grid away from coal, nuclear or natural gas to solar and wind. They claim solar or wind generated energy is cheap and better for the environment. But Texas proved renewable energy is neither, cheap, reliable or even available when you need it.
I have personal experience with renewable energy. I've install solar on my workshop at our farm and plan to install solar on our new home we are currently building. What I've learned about solar power is that it is unreliable and expensive. In Mississippi solar panels are only expected to generate power about 4.5 hours/day. So that leaves almost 20 hours of the day that we must use some other form of energy. In our case we must buy power from the power company that other 20 hours and sometimes even during the day if we are using more power than our solar panels can generate.
Here is a graph depicting a typical day and how much power we produce
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a8b39157-a5bb-435e-939e-451e4615ee91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
June 3, 2023 was a hot sunny day in north Mississippi, so our solar system generated as much power as it possible could. But even on a good day it only produces power during the middle of the day. So during the morning, late afternoon and evening we have to buy power from the grid.
You may ask about batteries. Batteries would be a great addition to our system and we plan to add a bank of batteries so we can store extra power produced during the day and use it at night. But batteries are extremely expensive, they will cost almost as much as the rest of the system.
Solar with batteries might be an answer for me at home but its not an answer for the entire state. The power grid does not store power because it is impossible to have a battery bank large enough. Power companies must generate the amount of power needed for that moment, so if they are depending on solar their power source is unreliable.
Solar is not reliable enough to create a base-load of power nor is it flexible enough to supply the peaks of usage. Which means when the [Public Service Commission](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8f4824b6-b0e8-47b2-b587-823ad89bda7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) approves a solar farm they are ensuring the power supplied to Mississippians will be more expensive and less reliable and the Biden agenda of leaving everyone in the dark will continue to move forward.
The majority of power produced for Mississippians is produced by natural gas. A natural gas power plant can easily be turned up to produce more power when needed. If we fall for the renewable energy lie and shut down our natural gas plants we will find ourselves in the cold just like Texas.
The Public Service Commissioners are responsible for ensuring our state has a steady supply of cheap, reliable power. To accomplish this goal they must resist the pressure put on them by the Biden administration and those who worship at the feet of the renewable energy gods.

clean_body: Mississippi Politicians are helping | | ---|---|--- | | | or ? ? from the desk ofDana Criswell Is solar an answer for Mississippi? | | | Jun 28 | | | | | | | | | | by on Electricity is probably one of the most important modern-day conveniences man has ever experienced. Just look around and take note of everything using electricity. It's amazing to think how the ability to harness this natural power affects our lives. Cheap, easily available electricity is one of the reasons the quality of life in the United States is well above the vast majority of the world. Thanks for reading Dana Criswell! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. ? The Biden administration and the rest of the hate-America crowd are working overtime to destroy our access to cheap, abundant energy. If you lived in Texas during the winter of 2021 you remember the extreme winter blast that sent the entire state of Texas into record breaking cold temperatures. Texans turned up the heat demanding electricity like never before, but this demand created a shortage of power and produced black-outs throughout the entire state. Why did Texas run out of electricity and what can we do in Mississippi to ensure we never have the same experience? Texas has fallen prey to the religion of renewable energy and in 2021 it left them in the cold. Those who worship at the alter of renewable energy tell us we must transition our energy grid away from coal, nuclear or natural gas to solar and wind. They claim solar or wind generated energy is cheap and better for the environment. But Texas proved renewable energy is neither, cheap, reliable or even available when you need it. I have personal experience with renewable energy. I've install solar on my workshop at our farm and plan to install solar on our new home we are currently building. What I've learned about solar power is that it is unreliable and expensive. In Mississippi solar panels are only expected to generate power about 4.5 hours/day. So that leaves almost 20 hours of the day that we must use some other form of energy. In our case we must buy power from the power company that other 20 hours and sometimes even during the day if we are using more power than our solar panels can generate. Here is a graph depicting a typical day and how much power we produce | | ---|---|--- June 3, 2023 was a hot sunny day in north Mississippi, so our solar system generated as much power as it possible could. But even on a good day it only produces power during the middle of the day. So during the morning, late afternoon and evening we have to buy power from the grid. You may ask about batteries. Batteries would be a great addition to our system and we plan to add a bank of batteries so we can store extra power produced during the day and use it at night. But batteries are extremely expensive, they will cost almost as much as the rest of the system. Solar with batteries might be an answer for me at home but its not an answer for the entire state. The power grid does not store power because it is impossible to have a battery bank large enough. Power companies must generate the amount of power needed for that moment, so if they are depending on solar their power source is unreliable. Solar is not reliable enough to create a base-load of power nor is it flexible enough to supply the peaks of usage. Which means when the approves a solar farm they are ensuring the power supplied to Mississippians will be more expensive and less reliable and the Biden agenda of leaving everyone in the dark will continue to move forward. The majority of power produced for Mississippians is produced by natural gas. A natural gas power plant can easily be turned up to produce more power when needed. If we fall for the renewable energy lie and shut down our natural gas plants we will find ourselves in the cold just like Texas. The Public Service Commissioners are responsible for ensuring our state has a steady supply of cheap, reliable power. To accomplish this goal they must resist the pressure put on them by the Biden administration and those who worship at the feet of the renewable energy gods. By the way - There are two candidates for Northern District Public Service Commissioner, and Tanner Newman. Newman has received thousands of dollars from solar farm companies for his campaign. There is little doubt about where his loyalty lies, and it is not with the people of north Mississippi. Mississippi needs cheap, reliable power. Thanks for reading Dana Criswell! Peter, An extraordinary series of events unfolded in Russia over the weekend and the longer term implications may not be felt for some time. But if there is one early takeaway for the American people from the recent news, it's how vitally important it is that our nation has a strong foreign policy apparatus, and that we put real effort into maintaining relationships with our allies.

Most of those nations look to the United States for guidance and intelligence sharing to act in concert with allied interests when international situations arise. This is good for our own country’s safety and security, and also a component of our our economic power in an increasingly connected world.

While it's true that America shouldn't always act as the world’s police force, what gets lost in that debate is how important it is to fight for democratic principles, and how that has a direct impact on our way of life.

That is why I have been so disappointed seeing some voices in the Republican Party suggesting that we shouldn't be supporting Ukraine or fighting to strengthen NATO. If we turn our backs on our allies, it will expedite the rise of autocratic nations like China, embolden other dictators around the world, and weaken our country.

As we look ahead to the upcoming presidential election, it's my hope that both parties will offer candidates who understand these priorities and pledge to stand for democracy. Every president since World War II seems to have understood this other than President Trump, who degraded relationships with our closest allies and seems intent on continuing that wrong-headed course.

It's too early to know for sure the fallout from what is happening in Russia and how it ultimately impacts us here in the United States, but I remain hopeful that our elected leaders in Washington will understand how important it is for us to continue fighting for freedom.
---

| | Peter,
---
| **I’m delighted to announce that the City of Enumclaw City Council Member and Mayor Pro Tem has endorsed my Congressional campaign!**

Councilman Wright has been a steadfast defender of his residents’ freedoms!
---

| **Councilman Wright shared the following statement:**

_“I am proud to endorse Carmen Goers for the 8th congressional district. Enumclaw is a community that prides itself on its independence, family values and being a hub for small businesses. Carmen, as a commercial banker, knows that over regulation and taxation can not only kill small businesses, but suffocate opportunity. Carmen and I spoke of faith, family and community. Carmen understands how important those are in both our lives and to the citizens of Enumclaw. I know that in Congress Carmen will not only be a champion for us here on the Plateau, but the entire eighth congressional district. I am proud to support her and her journey to become our next Congresswoman.”_

_**I am honored to receive the endorsement of Councilman Wright**_. I share Councilman Wright's belief in the importance of small businesses and the need for policies that promote growth and opportunity.

I’m grateful for Councilman Wright’s recognition of my awareness as a commercial banker. My firsthand experience in seeing the impacts of overregulation and excessive taxation in our economy has fueled my desire to protect the lifeblood of our communities: small businesses.

**When elected to Congress** , I will work tirelessly to be a strong advocate for the residents of Enumclaw and the entire 8th Congressional District. Together, we will champion limited government, individual freedoms, family values, and community partnerships while advancing policies that empower our constituents and create a brighter future for all.

Peter,

June ends this Friday at midnight and I need your help.

When the month ends, we’re required to report all of our fundraising progress from the last three months to the Federal Election Commission (FEC) and it’s a crucial test of campaign strength.

body:
Here’s what we’re doing about it.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1166%2E120351%2EKtRk2c)
Hey Peter, it’s Tara — Founder and Publisher of Courier Newsroom.
In a moment, I’m going to share how you can help us fight back against our country’s growing information crisis — and explain why this work is more important than ever.
**But if you’re short on time, here’s the gist:**
At Courier Newsroom, we’re fighting bad information by providing local news to the communities that need it most. But for us to keep our work free and accessible, we need your help to reach our **$15,000 end-of-quarter goal.**
[**The issue is, our fundraising has slowed way down. Hitting our goal by midnight on Friday isn’t impossible, but it’s going to take us seeing a big surge in grassroots support today to get us there. Every dollar donated helps, so will you chip in $5 now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230628?refcode=em20230628&refcode2=1166_120351_KtRk2c&akid=1166%2E120351%2EKtRk2c)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230628?refcode=em20230628&refcode2=1166_120351_KtRk2c&akid=1166%2E120351%2EKtRk2c)**
As the presidential race ramps up, it’s feeling more and more like the lead-up to the 2016 election that landed Trump in the White House. **Here’s what I mean:**
* The mainstream media is giving Trump wall-to-wall coverage, **ignoring** important local news stories — including high-stakes elections.
* Trump and his MAGA cronies are flooding social media with **misinformation** — with hardly any consequences.
* Local newsroom closures and layoffs are leaving communities in **‘news deserts’** — without a trustworthy source of information.

Peter, we’ve all seen what happens when all of these factors come together. They lead to widespread distrust in our democracy that divides our communities — or even stoke political violence like we saw on January 6th.
**At Courier Newsroom, we’re doing everything we can to drown out this bad information with good information.**
We don’t follow the same profit-driven playbook as the mainstream media. That means we don’t hide our stories behind paywalls or publish sensational stories to boost ad revenue.
Instead, our dedicated, on-the-ground reporters focus on the stories that matter most to their communities and publish their work online to ensure we reach as many people as possible. Because of support from grassroots donors like you, we’re able to do things differently.
**But as the presidential race ramps up, so does our work. In order to keep it up, we have to reach our $15,000 fundraising goal before midnight on Friday.** Due to this fundraising slowdown, we’re in a bit of a time crunch — but I know how dedicated this grassroots team is. So I’m asking one more time:
[**Will you chip in $5 to support our newsrooms and fight back against disinformation?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230628?refcode=em20230628&refcode2=1166_120351_KtRk2c&akid=1166%2E120351%2EKtRk2c)

Thanks so much,
Tara McGowan

| | These days, the word "chaos" has become synonymous with the Republican majority in the House.
