name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: What Stonewall means for us today
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| We cannot mistake progress for victory.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=471%2E35263%2Ew9rQEV)
Peter, **Fifty four years ago, the New York City Police Department raided Stonewall Inn, a bar in the city’s Greenwich Village and safe haven for the LGBTQ community.** Several brave Americans, led by Black and brown trans activists, fought back against police violence and harassment. Demonstrations throughout the city happened over the span of six days, kickstarting the modern LGBTQ movement for equal rights. Stonewall is a story of those who came before us and put everything on the line in a demand to be treated with dignity and respect. Those who bravely stood up and spoke out so that others wouldn’t have to live in fear or silence. Progress was made possible by the Black and brown trans activists who have always been on the frontlines of the fight for LGBTQ rights. We must never forget that. I’m inspired by how far we’ve come in the past 54 years, but as Republicans continue to attack LGBTQ rights — targeting and dehumanizing trans kids, banning LGBTQ discussion in our schools, and even threatening to overturn Supreme Court decisions that granted our right to marriage equality — it’s clear there is so much more work to be done. **It’s going to take all of us to counter these right wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong.** **[Will you join the fight to help me continue making a difference and advancing our progress by pitching into my reelection campaign today?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun23.CtqEq3&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230628_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=471%2E35263%2Ew9rQEV)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2151?c0=tbe-em-jun23.0mNvpg&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230628_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=471%2E35263%2Ew9rQEV)

body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2850b9593543497aae7d5dac29fe1e03&_e=7-UmaxMMb1p8M-e-SRTNrkud2qnt2gKPJV36JqnJrCsi1ugFDguofCZwvPyDaC_sq4SmQy99_NiO1nQOhFQsy7ag58SfmCw1LAHZVyAV0iQTQ2Yv-lgA3u4CPcq7a9B15iFQQUGi6MMaOW8fzN9aR6JTkMHdnQafJzusAKF9zLl2qFrjYXnidxdlBFDcat09nnKTY5FwQoOMtq3Md6z9O-RDo_6LqpHHiIOJqLBZkuRrSbnbEbYHhPZJJXzeJP5-nJI7qKlf5W1hus4KrCD1zzPbsF0nnVxuou0ogXB3-Ux27RFkmi5of5f7Dy5MDQ3pKRSeV1NynzydRr-bPOpgyrAhxaW_n8WXQWLcE3hr6HihNPOLukd4JRT29w8u9ydGQf-Ao1HyjHlwCf1aIxlk2tpFOpWh2S_AiT1nuqQcB_U%3D)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2850b9593543497aae7d5dac29fe1e03&_e=7-UmaxMMb1p8M-e-SRTNrkud2qnt2gKPJV36JqnJrCsi1ugFDguofCZwvPyDaC_sq4SmQy99_NiO1nQOhFQsy7ag58SfmCw1LAHZVyAV0iQTQ2Yv-lgA3u4CPcq7a9B15iFQQUGi6MMaOW8fzN9aR6JTkMHdnQafJzusAKF9zLl2qFrjYXnidxdlBFDcat09nnKTY5FwQoOMtq3Md6z9O-RDo_6LqpHHiIOJqLBZkuRrSbnbEbYHhPZJJXzeJP5-nJI7qKlf5W1hus4KrCD1z_6rMEPka7r1aWniZn9PauZzFLoF3BTTJxjzg8sfe8qPvbaV9K0uzgmMkjJXKm4BgtSLoMYdxjSz24z2q0zCuCGi8AfIoV9I_UdDloEOcea_JK6-k68diQcqAtHmkhjQK-HFNmUtaCxYd0_vAt_Vgr8%3D).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

body:
We're just days away from our first quarterly fundraising goal since we learned I'll be facing Daniel Cameron in November. Peter,

In just a few days, the first financial quarter of the general election comes to a close. [**In a moment, I'm going to ask you to chip in to my re-election before the quarter ends so that we can protect the progress we're making for Kentucky.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65559762/413842172/907170691?refcode=em23_230628_eoq1_fndd_gq_nopn___AB_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230628_eoq1_fndd_gq_nopn___AB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=1f448b36-d515-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjQ0OGIzNi1kNTE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NuybY0dn4wwE5hCwQrsjHDYJWyzWghl2WN94HFByRVw=) But first, I want to catch you up on this race and share why your support is so critical.

In 2019, I won the race for Kentucky governor by just over 5,000 votes. Since then, we've restored voting rights to 180,000 Kentuckians, expanded health care access, legalized medical marijuana and sports gaming, created tens of thousands of jobs, and achieved the lowest unemployment rate in the history of the Commonwealth.

# SCOTTY MOORE ANNOUNCES RUN FOR FLORIDA HOUSE DISTRICT 35
### ORLANDO - On Monday, June 10th, Republican Scotty Moore announced his intenton to seek the Florida House of Representatives, District 35 seat. The seat is currently held by State Representative Fred Hawkins. Hawkins recently announced he will resign from that seat to pursue a state government position. There will likely be a special election in upcoming months.
“Ester and I are honored to announce that I am seeking the position to serve our community and state as Republican candidate for Florida House District 35,” Moore began. “We cannot allow the woke, radical agenda that the Democrats ascribe to and push to gain any foothold in Florida. We must protect and continue to enhance the conservative policies being put forward by the State Legislature and Governor Ron DeSantis’ bold leadership. I believe it is essential we: Keep. Florida. Free. Moore ran for United States Congress in 2022, becoming the Republican nominee by winning a multi-candidate primary with 61% of the votes cast.
[](https://scottymooreforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13531191a7daf2aecc5c39a85&id=2feaf4c3cf&e=5e611ce1ba)
For over 20 years, Scotty worked at the largest Christian mission organization in the world, Campus Crusade for Christ; now known as Cru.
Throughout his career, Scotty has made it his mission to help people know Jesus and help transform their lives. He has the unique ability to connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime - leveraging his highly dynamic and energetic personality to win people over. He excels in casting vision, telling stories and developing lasting relationships that produce next-level results.
Scotty has coached people to reach their dream weight, assisted struggling marriages, coached individuals in their leadership and personal development and helped struggling businesses steady the ship and set a course for the future. He has traveled extensively and lived in Brazil for 6 years where he married his wife and learned to speak Portuguese on the streets of Brazil.
He strongly believes not all leaders are alike and that we need patriots who will courageously defend the Constitution, promote conservative principles that honor God and KEEP. FLORIDA. FREE.
Scotty holds a B.A. in Communication and has been married to Ester for 20 years. They have two daughters.

subject: My experience has prepared me for this
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I’ve fought and bled for America. Now, I’m looking to take my fight to the U.S. Senate.

|
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdj48p9rhpqd74254q29h03vmqelo9edokpjd4ag_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I'm a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I'll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I'm answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will step-up and serve our GREAT nation. **My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career.**

[**chip in any amount
Send a Navy SEAL to the Senate**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6sl9gur18ep58cuf9tokcdcoj49drlp9i6m8mlg_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)
You don't know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I've fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm.

Career politicians like Democrat Jon Tester, **who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years** , are not getting the job done. **[That's why I'm challenging him for his seat in the United States Senate.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z74f2ilgpbjhfju913c56m9t7d4bhqh05ukdb1e0_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs) **

**As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country – _and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture_ ** [**I'm prepared to sacrifice even more of myself for the betterment of all Americans.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdauhgspmgeu2qib60bqrjs1jtfknc1cue0apeko_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST.

When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn't just for four, six, or even 20 years - it's lifelong.

[**My mission continues in a different way now, and I'm asking you to support me not only with your prayers, but with your financial backing, too.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd8533ternrverkue3t0ji4pl3qgsimno4vmpn6o_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmtrjdtdeskurnovqmjvvt4l5opiqcck4e32m0b0_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)
During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I've been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces.

But, running to be Montana's next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet.

**Just look at where we are as a nation.** Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society.

_**I cannot - and will not - remain quiet when I know I can be of service to you and your family in the U.S. Senate.**_

[**I've been training for this moment my entire life, Fellow Conservative.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd5qnur3d8n6t42rsorbv6cc55kaomvjp84t5558_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

To accomplish this mission, it's going to take all of America working together as a TEAM. Our adversary is well-armed and has well insulated himself against attacks over his three-term career in D.C. That's why I'm going to be counting on having the best possible team around me to successfully navigate the terrain. [**Are you up for the task?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqd0cgksd2fv8dcf2r71mihpuue9ip2437gklqeo_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbf0gcjis82rc2mr42lsih9nebvh2grbv6f8gqlg_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)
I'm aware that this isn't going to be an easy race to win; you don't see people lining up to take on incumbents very often because truthfully, it isn't the easy thing to do. But as they say in the SEALS, _"nobody remembers a loser or a quitter."_

_**I can tell you this right now:[I'm going to be remembered as the guy who took down Jon Tester.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsl7o163n8bu4kjti79bpk5v0713bfqlml09jd10_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs) **_

[**Please, if you can, do me a favor and chip in $5, $10, $15 or even $25 right now.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjn42tbfbmldoqt6orgkba4nvkvna6o6uljb1860_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

We need real, competent leadership to save our country and protect the American Dream for future generations.

Montana can do better.

America can do better.

You deserve better.

Our veterans, my friends that didn't make it home, fought for better.

[**Join me.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfin87lq2oc2g5hjkr3ohvtndekti5q7hmkepigo_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

Hooyah,

Tim Sheehy
Former Navy SEAL
Republican for U.S. Senate

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5nbi03pguvn7sd7omigk982kq9d7084od31o1u8_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

|

WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL."

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6ogtrt5am8jsst3gt1ov0af78760p1kpujfviso_rp22sh2s8i66o77cjgeeo31c5h2bs)

We’re talking about _attacks on our immigrant communities._
We’re talking about _attacks on our LGBTQ communities._

We’re talking about _tax breaks for the massive corporations and the ultra-wealthy._
And we’re even talking about _attacks on our free and fair elections_ — the cornerstone of our democracy.
Alex is working hard to support his colleagues in tough races across the country — but he can’t do it alone. No one can.
**The ONLY way we’re going to maintain our majority in the Senate and keep making progress for California and the country is if folks like you step up and get involved.**

The truth is, right now I am the only presidential candidate with a vision to solve the issues facing America today. From reviving our national identity to unleashing our economy and declaring independence from communist China, my vision is focused on a national revival, not a national divorce. **Together, we can take America First to the next level.**

# MICHIGAN LIGHTHOUSE MINISTRIES
---
| |
---
| |
# OUR MISSION
Michigan Lighthouse Ministries is partnering with pastors, to educate, encourage, and mobilize their congregations to stand up, speak up, and show up. Our Founders understood this and were involved in promoting the Christian faith in all three of God’s ordained institutions.
---
|
---
| Founder Ralph Rebandt was a candidate for Michigan Governor in the 2022 primary election. That platform provided him with a unique perspective on the election process and numerous opportunities to engage with the Michigan electorate and Michigan churches. During the campaign he was known for highlighting America’s Christian heritage and bringing that discussion back into the public conversation. It has been stated that Michigan politics will never be the same because of his bold leadership to restore our Judeo-Christian values. Having served as lead pastor for Oakland Hills Community Church for 35 years, he was involved in the development of three additional churches before retiring to run for governor. Ralph presently serves on the Board of Governors for the Council for National Policy, Washington D.C., and as chaplain for the Michigan Association of Chiefs of Police, Southeastern Michigan Chiefs of Police, Farmington Hills Police Department, and Beverly Hills Police Department. He is actively involved in speaking engagements all around the state of Michigan in churches, at community events, and on law enforcement platforms. After receiving a Bachelor's Degree in Religious Education from Summit University in Clarks Summit, Pennsylvania, Ralph earned a Master's Degree in Religious Education and M. Div. at Westminster Seminary in Philadelphia where he graduated magna cum laude and acquired credits in the Ph.D. program. subject: Decline is NOT inevitable
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I believe in American Greatness. Do you?

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27684%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=HtEaKe7tnQE8bWxRU6IEOQ&sysid=1)
---
Friend, I'm running for President because I don't believe the decline of our country is inevitable. I believe it's a choice that stands before us. **We have it in our power to choose a better path --a path that's going to lead to the revival of this country and a restoration of American Greatness.**
---
| | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA--JOIN THE FIGHT](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27695%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ui02OiBLprqeMt0yWgpljg&sysid=1)
---
I believe in this American Greatness, Friend. I’ve spent my life fighting for it. Long before I was elected governor, I served our nation in Iraq as a JAG officer in support of SEAL Team 1. Having seen what the attacks of September 11th did to our country, I felt a responsibility to do my part to help at a time of struggle. _**So I served**_. Friend, the sense of satisfaction I got knowing that I was wearing the cloth of my country, serving alongside so many honorable patriots, and fighting for something bigger than myself was a satisfaction that money just can't buy. Today, our country has lost its sense of national pride.
* Instead of strengthening our military recruiting efforts and building a military for the future...
* Instead of securing our border and holding Mexican drug cartels accountable for the irrevocable harm they’ve done to our citizens...
* And instead of reigning in out-of-control economic and fiscal policy that have left us on the brink of bankruptcy...

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state’s infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

**In Case You Missed It:
Is Chris Christie Having A Moment**?
_“History Suggests That Someone Will Emerge From The Pack Of Single Digit Contenders To Make A Mark In One Of The Early States. Right Now That Candidate Looks Like Christie.”_
|
---
[**So What?**](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=45bc906cd5&e=d0a9afa930)**
Chris Cillizza
June 28, 2023**
“Two polls out in the last few days point to something interesting: Chris Christie is starting to catch on.
“An NBC News national poll put Christie at 5%, good for 4thplace and marginally ahead of the likes of Nikki Haley and Tim Scott.
“And a Saint Anselm College survey of New Hampshire votersputs Christie in 3rd place behind only Donald Trump and Ron DeSantis.
“That’s the second New Hampshire poll of late to showChristie making a move in the Granite State; he was at 9% in a survey releasedearlier this month.
“Which is interesting — because it suggests that Christie has received a bigger boost from his entrance into the race (on June 6) than some of his better-regarded competitors.
“And it also suggests there is at least some appetite for the anti-Trump message that Christie is selling — especially in New Hampshire.
“Trump, it appears, is noticing. ...
“As I have written before about Christie, I think he isuniquely positioned to make Trump uncomfortable (if anyone can).
“Christie is very media savvy — and very good on his feet. Which makes him someone that TV networks are regularly going to use (he was on ABC and Fox this past weekend). Which gets his name (and message) out there.(My guess is that Christie will be a standout in the first debate as well —whether or not Trump takes part.) ...
“All of which means that Trump will struggle to ignoreChristie’s repeated provocations. And by attacking Christie, he will likelycontinue to elevate the former New Jersey governor.
“This Christie bump is bad news for DeSantis, who is desperately trying to turn the race into a two-man affair. If Christie’s numbers continue to improve in New Hampshire, it’s very likely he is taking support away from DeSantis ...
“History suggests that someone will emerge from the pack of single digit contenders to make a mark in one of the early states. Right now that candidate looks like Christie.”
-###-

Friends, We all remember the tyranny that was forced upon us during the Covid-19 pandemic. State governors, both Democrat and Republican, shut down our businesses, closed our schools, and punished all who didn't comply. The reason most governors were able to do this was because of state laws granting them "emergency powers" in a time of crisis that gave them a broad mandate to enforce Covid restrictions. They abused these powers, keeping them in place far longer than they were intended, and the results were disastrous with all the evidence showing how lockdowns did more harm than good. Well, what if we told you that interest groups now want to make those "emergency powers" the standard in state law. The supposedly non-partisan Uniform Law Commission (ULC) has proposed model legislation for all 50 states that would do just that. The ULC is an entity that has been around since 1892 and works to draft model legislation in order to provide clarity to areas of statutory law across jurisdictions. They have now decided that it's important to give every governor in America the ability to unilaterally declare emergency public health powers whenever they want with no ability to challenge them in court. State Freedom Caucuses have already been fighting back against this abuse of power. Recently, the Arizona Freedom Caucus [passed](http://links.statefreedomcaucus.co/u/click?_t=1b6c04157c924c98ad4a6127d8bd1e6c&_m=195a7c57907244a0a2d0798803f75ad1&_e=bNQDkyHMeluFRmRcRWY1PL61D4JC6-jIYQ-tRqyYg4GP8ygGhRsNq2l6c7wgLufmrWqERihN_OKM6So3F3TOSulboFDFM964Uliq0zT6OAmqISxEGoCpEwa_OfxSpAu-LXGqBOcss8pdehkOYeWE3O0zKp7BJCDEeBBNIMOaV8yX1LJMSQvQC7Xh6tRb4gsvdxk-5V3nYCKeTdOnSU2cokIiu0-bJETkceDbkXqraKt_JIpu1BjS-PGIP8Jgl9yQ) HCR 2039, a ballot measure that will constitutionally terminate the Governor's emergency powers during a state of emergency after 30 days, should AZ voters approve it in the 2024 election. All eleven Freedom Caucuses in our network have vowed in writing to fight against the model legislation from the ULC. We will always oppose further concentrations of power in the executive branch and will never allow politicians to legislate away your rights. **South Carolina:** The SCFC had a major victory in court this week that ensured CRT would be removed from the Lexington County School District. Last October, the SCFC obtained a five-minute undercover recording of Tarika Sullivan, a professional development specialist for EL Education which contracted with the district, talking about how they plan to get around state laws to teach CRT to children. The SC Freedom Caucus wasted no time bringing them to court and a settlement was reached which requires the school district to terminate its contract with EL Education. The SCFC will always fight to keep divisive left-wing racial ideology out of the classroom. Read the full story in [Fox News](http://links.statefreedomcaucus.co/u/click?_t=1b6c04157c924c98ad4a6127d8bd1e6c&_m=195a7c57907244a0a2d0798803f75ad1&_e=bNQDkyHMeluFRmRcRWY1PPYSdVJ46XUAQsuzKiYE7a5ut68DyX7_ZCv0SK0yBK1EMGTSvqfSVYgsUJTjsHkhGEd9xEOGFt9FSR_T7j9dr1kJlLwUpXvFGVoPsNSh3wvArC3Q938nPkMwjPsZRWFQcfv3IpexFyGpOD2St3hKTI3VzknTZFimY4zly4lQA_kN_Lrctonp2ThCeNZXCjOPSFLgpe1rLdIHpKq2TH_plMyC7d2DgJ-K1YemWN3-KiwrgpbxLUkZ5i3pSp9cLaV3PFun7J7xzbXDRJlTxEHbr7qt7kuc_s0Qni1iED-SdES3). **Pennsylvania:** Responding to a written request by the PA Freedom Caucus, Penn State University's flagship hospital recently disclosed that they are prescribing puberty blockers and other gender change procedures to children as young as 5-years-old. Our caucuses will never stand for that, which is why they successfully whipped their colleagues last week into denying Penn State the two-thirds majority needed to receive funding from the legislature, denying the university $259 million - not just for their hospital but for ALL their funding. When hospitals are doing irreversible damage to our children, Freedom Caucuses will always fight to stop it. Read the full story in the [Daily Signal](http://links.statefreedomcaucus.co/u/click?_t=1b6c04157c924c98ad4a6127d8bd1e6c&_m=195a7c57907244a0a2d0798803f75ad1&_e=bNQDkyHMeluFRmRcRWY1PJjRY5XCg1AG2FjwhD6tiPJxWeZeomuLIqeThGqN6D-f3zH-Q33ugc4AgyCBJUZ1aN3R9QQ18FOGO4GXiohAhMvk1cTcwACnACrf6MV_I7ojAt1uSTm3M6U2gjtzcH7-xYlqtiKSTSQWoPMVlqQD_GPx-Hur8tG1WLHyu2Nj2clReosgErkQ09fnkUUaK8PxfneY0bsQeto3yJ9pLZ4eGSCzD_XwUseQF6ouTu5fs8c2TGFxWy49B_m_QW_2k1FYTP-_7EA8Kf3lFn_9pqPRlm21UuwEVLdNMunqBuFut02XjMMClQEfy0ewbbpvXqgfXA%3D%3D). **JOIN THE FIGHT** Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation's state capitols and in your home state. clean_body: We all remember the tyranny that was forced upon us during the Covid-19 pandemic. State governors, both Democrat and Republican, shut down our businesses, closed our schools, and punished all who didn’t comply. | | | | Friends, We all remember the tyranny that was forced upon us during the Covid-19 pandemic. State governors, both Democrat and Republican, shut down our businesses, closed our schools, and punished all who didn't comply. The reason most governors were able to do this was because of state laws granting them "emergency powers" in a time of crisis that gave them a broad mandate to enforce Covid restrictions. They abused these powers, keeping them in place far longer than they were intended, and the results were disastrous with all the evidence showing how lockdowns did more harm than good. Well, what if we told you that interest groups now want to make those "emergency powers" the standard in state law. The supposedly non-partisan Uniform Law Commission (ULC) has proposed model legislation for all 50 states that would do just that. The ULC is an entity that has been around since 1892 and works to draft model legislation in order to provide clarity to areas of statutory law across jurisdictions. They have now decided that it's important to give every governor in America the ability to unilaterally declare emergency public health powers whenever they want with no ability to challenge them in court. State Freedom Caucuses have already been fighting back against this abuse of power. Recently, the Arizona Freedom Caucus HCR 2039, a ballot measure that will constitutionally terminate the Governor's emergency powers during a state of emergency after 30 days, should AZ voters approve it in the 2024 election. All eleven Freedom Caucuses in our network have vowed in writing to fight against the model legislation from the ULC. We will always oppose further concentrations of power in the executive branch and will never allow politicians to legislate away your rights. South Carolina: The SCFC had a major victory in court this week that ensured CRT would be removed from the Lexington County School District. Last October, the SCFC obtained a five-minute undercover recording of Tarika Sullivan, a professional development specialist for EL Education which contracted with the district, talking about how they plan to get around state laws to teach CRT to children. The SC Freedom Caucus wasted no time bringing them to court and a settlement was reached which requires the school district to terminate its contract with EL Education. The SCFC will always fight to keep divisive left-wing racial ideology out of the classroom. Read the full story in . Pennsylvania: Responding to a written request by the PA Freedom Caucus, Penn State University's flagship hospital recently disclosed that they are prescribing puberty blockers and other gender change procedures to children as young as 5-years-old. Our caucuses will never stand for that, which is why they successfully whipped their colleagues last week into denying Penn State the two-thirds majority needed to receive funding from the legislature, denying the university $259 million - not just for their hospital but for ALL their funding. When hospitals are doing irreversible damage to our children, Freedom Caucuses will always fight to stop it. Read the full story in the . | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Derek, if you
didn’t get the chance to watch last week’s debate on the House floor
before the vote to censure Adam, you missed out on quite the circus when
the most extreme of the extreme MAGA Republicans took to the floor to go
after him.

This included Marjorie Taylor Greene, who attacked him for serving on the
January 6th Committee, claiming he perpetuated, “the fake narrative that
January 6 was an insurrection, and it was not.”

Then she made it clear what this sham resolution was really about:
Stopping Adam from running for Senate so that California can adopt
policies that she thinks would be more suitable for our state.

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| “Adam Schiff is running for Senate in California. California has a lot |
| of things messed up. California is not the model that the United |
| States needs. As a matter of fact their government policies are |
| atrocious.” — Marjorie Taylor Greene |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Thanks Marjorie, but we don’t need some hateful conspiracy theorist
telling us who Californians should elect to the Senate, or trashing our
state and the millions of people who make it wonderful.

But Derek, MTG
wasn’t the only MAGA crazy to sound off. Here is a taste of what Adam had
to confront:

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| “Schiff abused his privileges, claiming to know the truth, while |
| leaving Americans in the dark about his web of lies. Lies so severe |
| they altered the course of the country forever.” — Anna Paulina Luna |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| “If Adam Schiff has a shred of human decency left, he would resign |
| from Congress in disgrace. His tombstone should read of his failed |
| career in Congress and should be one word: Liar.” — Lauren Boebert |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

But for every blow the GOP tried to deal, Adam was defended by some of the
most wonderful Democrats in Congress — Nancy Pelosi, Hakeem Jeffries, Pete
Aguilar, Jim McGovern, Mike Quigley, and more — leaders who he is proud to
call friends.

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| “Today we are on the floor of the House, where the other side has |
| turned this body, this chamber – where slavery was abolished, where |
| Medicare and Social Security and everything were instituted – they’ve |
| turned it into a puppet show. A puppet show.” — Nancy Pelosi |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| “Adam Schiff has been an incredible member of Congress. He exposed |
| Trump’s lies and corruption, impeached him, and got a bipartisan |
| conviction vote in the Senate.” — Jim McGovern |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| “What really gnaws at the Majority, what really bothers them, is that |
| Mr. Schiff was way better than anybody on their team. At debate. At |
| leadership. At messaging. At legal knowledge. He kicked their ass.” — |
| Mike Quigley |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

But it was Adam who said it best, when he called out Republicans for their
cowardice. For the MAGA Republicans who are undoubtedly stalking our
emails, let us repeat him:

+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| “The question, my Republican colleagues, is not why am I the subject |
| of this false resolution for doing my constitutional duty, but why are |
| you not? Why are you not standing beside me, the subject of a similar |
| rebuke for speaking the truth? Why did you not stand up to Donald |
| Trump, why did you not reject his immorality, why did you not condemn |
| his dishonesty, why did you not speak out when his horde attacked our |
| Capitol, or now, when he treats the nation’s secrets with such |
| carelessness, lawlessness, and disdain, why did you hide from efforts |
| to hold him accountable, why were you silent, afraid, unwilling to do |
| your ethical, constitutional duty, why did you cower — why do you |
| still?” — Adam Schiff |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Derek, Adam’s
censure just proves how effective he’s been at confronting the endless
lies, and corruption perpetrated by Trump, McCarthy, and MAGA Republicans.
He’s defended our Constitution and country, and it was moving to hear his
colleagues praise that work as well.

The GOP is desperate to keep him out of the Senate because they know how
effective he is at holding them accountable. To be direct: they’re scared
as hell of what he can do to hold them accountable as a Senator.

And we’re going to make sure they find out.

This included Marjorie Taylor Greene, who attacked him for serving on the January 6th Committee, claiming he perpetuated, “the fake narrative that January 6 was an insurrection, and it was not.” Then she made it clear what this sham resolution was really about: Stopping Adam from running for Senate so that California can adopt policies that she thinks would be more suitable for our state. +------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | “Adam Schiff is running for Senate in California. Peter,

As Dr. Williams’ campaign manager, I’m so proud of the coalition of support we’ve built for this campaign already. In just over a month, we’ve reached tens of thousands of supporters with word about our efforts to create life-saving change for the country we love by electing the first trauma surgeon and first Black doctor with the ability to vote in Congress. Dr. Williams is the leader we need fighting for us and advocating in Washington for gun safety legislation, affordable healthcare for all, and reproductive freedoms.

| | | It's Marco. Please read this message to the end, but only if you're prepared to handle the reality of our situation. With only about 30% of folks opening these messages, I believe that by opening this, you're someone who can handle it. I know it's hard to tell fact from fiction these days, but I'm going to level with you and tell you the truth.

On top of only about 30% of our friends opening these messages, only about 1% will go the extra mile by donating. Conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to raise money for our cause, so I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you still think your $1 doesn't matter, then I want to simply thank you for hearing me out.

**Here's the truth...**

The Democrats stopped our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires I can call on to hit these goals. I rely on a couple of bucks here and there from hard-working Americans receiving these messages when they can afford it.

**If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit, we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' millions raised. I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a donut.**

body:
From growing up in Scranton, to coaching eighth-grade basketball in Philadelphia, to my wife, Terese, and I raising our four daughters in the same town where I grew up — Pennsylvania is my home.

Derek, I’m a lifelong Pennsylvanian.

From growing up in Scranton, to coaching eighth-grade basketball in Philadelphia, to my wife, Terese, and I raising our four daughters in the same town where I grew up — Pennsylvania is my home.

That’s why I’m a tireless advocate for Pennsylvania’s hardworking families in the U.S. Senate. Because I know how hard Pennsylvanians work to provide for their kids, save for their families’ futures, and give back to their communities. They deserve a Senator who works just as hard to represent their voices in Washington.

But here’s the reality: national Republicans are coming for this seat in hopes of regaining Senate control. These are the same folks who want to make cuts to Social Security, which nearly 3 million Pennsylvanians rely on to get by.

_The people of our state can’t afford a Republican Senate majority._

**[That’s why I need to ask for your early support in our re-election fight. Derek, I’m running for re-election to keep fighting for Pennsylvania families in the U.S. Senate, but I won’t be able to win without your support. Will you split a donation of $5 or any amount between Josh Shapiro and my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65572363/413887186/-1645383944?refcode=email_062823_jds-casey-split&amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODY3ZDRmYi1mMTE1LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_tNLCnBfXU8OhVB1fYqDsaV_vMTHXBt-NJH0_AGq1Zk=)**

With gratitude,

Bob

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
An important message from Dr. Bob's campaign manager, Kevin Numerick
ABOUT BOB [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
,
Dr. Bob Lorinser's decision to run for Congress again reflects a profound commitment to public service. With almost 15 years of experience working on political campaigns, I can confidently say that although first-time candidates rarely win, second-time candidates often do.
In the 2024 election, no one is better positioned than Dr. Bob Lorinser to defeat Jack Bergman.
Dr. Lorinser's dedication to serving others is truly remarkable. He has a long history of contributing to Northern Michigan and the UP, where he has raised his family and served the community through family medicine.
>From working with veterans at the VA to collaborating with the Navajo Nation and stepping up as a medical director during the challenging times of the COVID-19 pandemic, Dr. Lorinser has consistently demonstrated his commitment to improving the lives of those around him.
When you converse with Dr. Bob Lorinser, you will quickly realize that he embodies the qualities we need in a congressional representative. He possesses a level-headed and empathetic nature, and his willingness and ability to delve into the complexities of pressing issues make him an exceptional candidate.
I urge you to join me in supporting Dr. Bob Lorinser once again. As a seasoned candidate, he is even more prepared to fight like hell to defeat Jack Bergman.
On a personal note, as a concerned citizen, we desperately need Dr. Bob's presence in Congress.
Please join me in supporting Dr. Bob Lorinser and chip in $10, $50, or whatever you can afford today. Doing so is to help elect someone whose entire life has been focused on serving others and helping elect a representative who represents all of us. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
On June 30th, we hit our FEC quarterly fundraising deadline and hope to get 100 more donors before we close up the books for Q2.
Let's unite to support Dr. Bob Lorinser and work towards a brighter future for our community and nation.
Thank you, .
Kevin

Democrat, MI01

subject: Your Signature is Needed: Demand the EPA PROTECT pollinators and the planet
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1849677?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | _****Buzz Buzz****_ _Imagine that you are a thriving bumblebee, Friend. You are sweeping through the spring air from flower to flower. Landing on soft petals, consuming yummy rich nectar, and spreading pollen across the **green terrain.** You are bringing life to your surroundings for all living things!_**Life is sweet, like honey.** On your daily trail, you come across beautiful blossomed flowers. What a treat! You stop to sip nectar, but the nectar of these flowers harbors toxic pesticides. **You’ve been POISONED! Your body begins to TWITCH and TREMBLE uncontrollably -- you are PARALYZED and DYING.** Friend, bees do not stand a chance against toxic pesticides like neonics. But the Environmental Protection Agency is set to approve the continued use of these toxic chemicals for the _**next 15 years!**_ [_**BEE the change you want to see, Friend! Act NOW to demand the EPA protect our pollinators >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1849678?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1849679?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
A planet without pollinators would be a pale, dull world - our ecosystems and food system depend on them. In fact, bees are responsible for **1 in 3 bites of food we eat!** Nutritious veggies, fruit, and nuts could**DISAPPEAR** from our grocery store shelves if we do not take necessary action against corporate greed and negligence.
And in just 20 years, the population of what once was one of our most common species of bumblebee has _**plummeted by 90 PERCENT!**_ The EPA could step up and ban these toxic pesticides -- **_but we need YOUR help to push it to act._ [Please, Friend, will you do right by bees, our food system, and the planet by prioritizing pollinator health? Add your name now >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1849680?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1849679?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

body:
Representative Greene wasn’t even using a dog whistle — it was a bullhorn.

| Hey Peter, it’s Congressman Jamaal Bowman. I just want to make one thing clear:

In her press conference in front of countless reporters Marjorie Taylor Greene said something incredibly dangerous — calling me “aggressive” and saying she feels “threatened” by me.

**Representative Greene wasn’t even using a dog whistle — it was a bullhorn, putting a racist target on my back to her MAGA supporters.** It echoes what happened with Emmett Till and with Mike Brown, and unfortunately this country has a history of characterizing Black men who are outspoken, who stand their ground, or who push back as being “threatening” or “intimidating.”

Marjorie Taylor Greene is a white supremacist. Describing somebody’s beliefs – which are clear for everybody to see — isn’t “like calling a person of color the n word,” no matter what false equivalencies she might draw.

This behavior is dangerous and reckless — but we can’t let it stop our movement for progressive change.

everyone is going to be watching

In just two days, Lauren Boebert and I are facing a federally-mandated fundraising deadline. After midnight Friday, we’ll both be required by law to file a report with the Federal Election Commission (FEC) saying how much we’ve raised and from how many donors. This is our most important FEC report of the campaign so far, and our fundraising numbers will be closely compared with Boebert’s. It’s also our first opportunity to once again out-raise Lauren Boebert – purely with the help of grassroots donors like you – and shock everyone. Last year, our race was the closest race in the country. After the recount was finished, I lost to Boebert by just 546 votes. But with Lauren Boebert now on notice, her Super PACs are going to raise millions to attack me – and their lie-filled ads are sure to follow. This is our opportunity to show Boebert, every political pundit, and the Democratic and Republican establishment that we will send Lauren Boebert packing in 2024. hey, friend, I wanted to make sure you saw this email from our finance team and send you a personal request before this major deadline. subject: It happened to me, and it’s happening to women and girls everywhere.
body:
How long are we going to let this happen?

| |
---
| | | _It happened to me, and it 's happening to women and girls everywhere._

Now, it's trickling down into our youth sports. Recently, two California teens took TWO of the top three positions to qualify for the state track finals. Both teens were biological males. Both teens previously competed against other young men.

Worse yet, both teens took places at the podium over women but **FAILED** to show up for the preliminary finals.

I am absolutely disgusted. _**How long will we let the transgender mob destroy the rights women worked so hard for?**_

I am teaming up with Marsha Blackburn to SAVE women's sports, but Joe Biden and the Democrats are determined to shut us down and silence us.

Well, if you know one thing about me - there is no world where I will let that happen.

That's why I'm reaching out to you today. Joe Biden has vowed to veto any legislation that prevents biological men from competing in women's sports. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom – even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican – as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state’s infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

Growing up in the Bronx, I had no family, no friends, and no neighbors who were openly gay. I was blinded by fear to see my own value and equality – _and terrified to come out of the closet._

Since making the brave decision to come out, not a day goes by that I take for granted being able to live proudly as an out gay man and serve my community as an elected official.

**It’s impossible to overstate the power of representation.** My experience as an LGBTQ person has made me far more authentic as an elected official than I otherwise would be.

I believe in normalizing the power of my own visibility, so that young people can grow up without shame, _but with pride in who they are._

**So with attacks on the LGBTQ community at an all time high, it’s more important than ever to have LGBTQ people of color in the room where decisions are being made.**

[This always has been – _and will always continue to be_ – one of my top priorities as a member of Congress. So Peter, I’m personally asking you to join my fight for equality by chipping in $3 today. Friend, It is shameful that in the richest nation in the history of the world, children are going to bed hungry. The costs of raising a child in our country are among the highest in the world, and the U.S. is also one of the only industrialized countries that does not offer a single day of paid family or medical leave. With systemic racism in our country’s reproductive care, we’re also facing a Black maternal and infant health crisis. Black infants are more than twice as likely to die as white infants—a disparity greater than existed in 1850. Black women are also three times more likely to die during pregnancy than white women. **As a mama and founder of the Mamas’ Caucus in Congress, I refuse to accept this status quo.** I’m making sure that we center mothers of color in the policies we champion in Congress, from reducing poverty and reinstating the child tax credit, to closing the racial and gender wealth gap, to ensuring a national paid family and medical leave program, to investing in affordable childcare, to establishing healthcare equity and housing for all. I’m committed to making the transformative changes that families of color and working-class families deserve.
For example, more than 30 million workers do not have access to a single day of paid leave. That includes 67% of low-wage workers, most of whom are women and people of color.
Clearly, our country’s policies and institutions have too often failed families of color, and this needs to change.
**In partnership with Mothering Justice, I founded the Mamas’ Caucus to include women of color in the legislative decisions that impact them and their loved ones. We’re committed to advocating for all mothers that have been excluded from policymaking for so long.**
With the Mamas’ Caucus and the newly established Dads’ Caucus, we’re building partnerships in Congress to fight for policies that support every family, including a national paid leave program and providing high-quality childcare and early education programs that pay providers a living wage.
We’re also advocating for legislation to lift people out of poverty, such as my bill the _End Child Poverty Act_ , which would provide families with close to a $400/month payment per child, cutting deep child poverty by 70%.
Policies like this will make it easier for working class people to afford necessities like diapers and childcare, and will provide a long overdue social safety net for our nation’s working families and children.

clean_body: uplifting working-class families | | | Friend, It is shameful that in the richest nation in the history of the world, children are going to bed hungry. The costs of raising a child in our country are among the highest in the world, and the U.S. is also one of the only industrialized countries that does not offer a single day of paid family or medical leave. With systemic racism in our country’s reproductive care, we’re also facing a Black maternal and infant health crisis. Black infants are more than twice as likely to die as white infants—a disparity greater than existed in 1850. Black women are also three times more likely to die during pregnancy than white women. As a mama and founder of the Mamas’ Caucus in Congress, I refuse to accept this status quo. I’m making sure that we center mothers of color in the policies we champion in Congress, from reducing poverty and reinstating the child tax credit, to closing the racial and gender wealth gap, to ensuring a national paid family and medical leave program, to investing in affordable childcare, to establishing healthcare equity and housing for all. | I’m committed to making the transformative changes that families of color and working-class families deserve. For example, more than 30 million workers do not have access to a single day of paid leave. That includes 67% of low-wage workers, most of whom are women and people of color. Clearly, our country’s policies and institutions have too often failed families of color, and this needs to change. In partnership with Mothering Justice, I founded the Mamas’ Caucus to include women of color in the legislative decisions that impact them and their loved ones. We’re committed to advocating for all mothers that have been excluded from policymaking for so long. With the Mamas’ Caucus and the newly established Dads’ Caucus, we’re building partnerships in Congress to fight for policies that support every family, including a national paid leave program and providing high-quality childcare and early education programs that pay providers a living wage. We’re also advocating for legislation to lift people out of poverty, such as my bill the End Child Poverty Act , which would provide families with close to a $400/month payment per child, cutting deep child poverty by 70%. Policies like this will make it easier for working class people to afford necessities like diapers and childcare, and will provide a long overdue social safety net for our nation’s working families and children. name: Megan via Team Sara
subject: What it means to miss a goal
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Hi Team, yesterday Congresswoman Sara Jacobs sent an email detailing the big, $3,500 goal we set for the end of the quarter and I wanted to give some context on exactly what it means if we miss the mark this week. But first, if you didn’t get the chance to contribute yesterday, please consider giving $5, $10, $20, or whatever is meaningful to you right now to help us hit our goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I'LL CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Serving as a Member of Congress is a full-time job, and so is running for re-election. Sara has a lot on her plate, from taking meetings and calls with the people she represents to drafting legislation and defending it on the House floor, attending her committee meetings, and coming up with tangible solutions to the problems we’re facing.
And then there’s the work that goes into running – bringing people into the electoral process for the very first time, talking to people in the community, and educating potential voters about their power to make a difference.
This is deep work that requires a ton of time and energy – and it’s why we send these fundraising emails. When we miss a goal, no matter how big or small, Sara has to put some of that work on the back burner so we can rebalance the budget and double down on our efforts to raise funds to support this work.
And when we miss a BIG goal with a deadline like the one we’re facing on Friday, there’s so much more at stake.
Low-performing fundraising results are enough to impact whether we win or lose next November.
It’s a scary thought that can become a reality if we don’t put in the work right now. With only 2 days to go until the FEC deadline, if you haven’t donated yet, please consider pitching in any amount right now to help close that gap and ensure we don’t miss our goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thanks so much for your support.
-Megan

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I need to be direct
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC
body:
I’ll just be blunt: If you’re in a place where you can make a contribution to support my re-election campaign today, it will be a huge help. Let me explain:
Earlier this year, I officially announced that I’m running for re-election to the Senate. Now we’re up against a big test this week: Our first official fundraising deadline after running our campaign for a full quarter.
After Friday’s deadline, we’ll tally up all the donations we’ve received this quarter, and we’ll prepare our quarterly report for the Federal Election Commission (the FEC you’ve probably seen mentioned in more than a few emails). Then they’ll make our report public.
The total amount raised matters, yes, but here’s the number I’ll really have my eye on: The total number of contributions. Because that’s the number that shows the breadth of our grassroots campaign.
That’s the number that shows just how many people believe that we need to pass a wealth tax, Supreme Court Justices should follow a basic code of ethics, quality child care should not eat up an entire paycheck, and that the filibuster must be abolished so we can pass the laws that the majority of Americans are calling for — like protecting abortion rights and enacting gun safety laws.
[**So if making a financial contribution would make sense right now, could you split a contribution between to support The Long Run and my re-election campaign? Your contribution will help hit our goal so we can keep campaigning for these plans, and will demonstrate the strength of our movement to those who are trying to stop us.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em230628-2-t23&t=1&akid=4595%2E196590%2EbQRLoX)
Now, when this report comes out, GOP strategists will dig into the numbers — so will powerful special interests and their swarms of lobbyists — to evaluate the strength of our campaign.
Why? Because I am fighting with everything I’ve got to defeat their extremism and put power into the hands of working people. And if Republicans have more support and gain more power, they’d have more ability to pass their far-right agenda and block progress on the plans this movement is fighting for.
They’ll want to use our fundraising results to see what they’re up against and gauge if our plans are popular. Let’s give them something to worry about.
Every contribution helps show that our grassroots team for big, structural change is stronger than their push for extremist, harmful regression. And we’re building our grassroots campaign brick by brick, donation by donation.
[**In order to hit our goals, win this campaign, and make our plans happen, we’re relying on a strong response to this email today. So if you’re able to, please split a contribution to support The Long Run and my re-election campaign ahead of our next critical FEC fundraising deadline — and help power our fight.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em230628-2-t23&t=2&akid=4595%2E196590%2EbQRLoX)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
P.S. I want you to know that I never expect you to donate to every email, and I’m always grateful to work alongside you no matter how much, how often, or whether you’re able to contribute. Thank you.

_"Rumpled." "Disheveled." "Wrinkled."_

Each morning when I wake up, the first thing on my mind is fighting for Ohioans and the Dignity of Work – not competing for the Senate’s best dressed. That’s why sometimes, “rumpled,” “wrinkled,” and “disheveled” are the words used to describe me.

And I get it, friend. Most days, you're much more likely to find me in a Guardians sweatshirt or t-shirt than a suit and tie.

I'm running for reelection to continue fighting for the Dignity of Work – all work. Whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, work for tips or earn a salary, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you. And fighting for all workers doesn’t require the perfect wardrobe.
**Today though, I'm asking you to have a little faith in me and our campaign, rumpled suit and all. Dear Friends,
I am reaching out to invite you to a Cocktail Reception with Presidential Candidate Vivek Ramaswamy at The Residences at the Ritz Carlton Philadelphia on Friday, July 7 at 3:30 PM.
Vivek Ramaswamy is a 37-year-old graduate of Harvard, Yale Law School, a biotech entrepreneur, and a three-time author. Now he is running for President of the United States. Most recently a [Morning Consult Poll](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/11f00211-38b2-404a-a85f-0062e4fb9c20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with over 3,600 registered voters had Vivek polling at 6% nationwide, ahead of well-established politicians such as Tim Scott, Nikki Haley, and Chris Christie.
And just now Fox News released their latest poll that shows Vivek in 3rd place.

When I married Heidi, I promised to support all of her goals—the big ones, the small ones, and everything in between.
I know that she has an important End of Quarter Fundraising Deadline coming up soon, and I need your support to help me help her team reach it.

Heidi has lived her whole life fighting for justice and advocating for her community, Peter.

name: Sepi Shyne
subject: Bringing the fight of Stonewall to the halls of Congress
body:
Hey team,

Fifty-four years ago today, in the early morning hours on a street in Greenwich Village, a police raid at the Stonewall Inn sparked an uprising that galvanized a movement for the rights of LGBTQ+ people across the globe.

Led by courageous transgender activists of color and countless Gay, Lesbian and Bisexual activists who had been marginalized and even criminalized simply for living as their authentic selves, Stonewall was a turning point in our country’s struggle for justice and equity for all.

Although the Stonewall Uprising happened before I was born, there is barely a day that goes by where I’m not reminded of the power of this moment and the legacy it left for generations of LGBTQ+ activists.

From marriage equality, to HIV/AIDS justice, to transgender rights, and to the record number of LGBTQ+ people running for office, the voices of Stonewall vibrantly echo throughout the justice movements of today calling on us to keep going, to keep fighting, and to keep _celebrating_ our full, beautiful authentic selves.

[**I am running for Congress to keep the spirit of Stonewall alive, and do right by the activists who led the way, but I’ll need your support to get there. Chip in $5 whatever you can to finish the work Stonewall started and protect and empower our LGBTQ+ community.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65580465/413912967/-1104872842?refcode=em23_230628_EOQ3_fndd_gq_act___SS_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230628_EOQ3_fndd_gq_act___SS_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=ee813db2-0b16-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM5MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWU4MTNkYjItMGIxNi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6V7rZEJqcS0yS_4_dItyuef2OohoMK-EOHdOOuHtzS0=)

I often think back to the words of Marsha P. Johnson when she said, _"No pride for some of us without liberation for all of us."_

As a nation, we have a long way to go to fulfill the dreams and aspirations of Stonewall. Violence against our LGBTQ+ community is on the rise, hateful, transphobic laws are being passed all across the country, and the mere discussion of LGBTQ+ identities is still considered so shameful it has been outright banned in some places.

But Stonewall reminds us that — even in the wake of hate and ugliness — there is nothing we can’t do when we stand together as one voice in defiance of those who seek to divide us.

clean_body: Hey team, Fifty-four years ago today, in the early morning hours on a street in Greenwich Village, a police raid at the Stonewall Inn sparked an uprising that galvanized a movement for the rights of LGBTQ+ people across the globe. Led by courageous transgender activists of color and countless Gay, Lesbian and Bisexual activists who had been marginalized and even criminalized simply for living as their authentic selves, Stonewall was a turning point in our country’s struggle for justice and equity for all. Although the Stonewall Uprising happened before I was born, there is barely a day that goes by where I’m not reminded of the power of this moment and the legacy it left for generations of LGBTQ+ activists. From marriage equality, to HIV/AIDS justice, to transgender rights, and to the record number of LGBTQ+ people running for office, the voices of Stonewall vibrantly echo throughout the justice movements of today calling on us to keep going, to keep fighting, and to keep celebrating our full, beautiful authentic selves. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- I often think back to the words of Marsha P.
